detect_signal: ^(FLOW_PLAN_RECORD: error - the lanes table leaves these listed lanes unanswered: Harness|DELEGATED_PRODUCT_CHANGE: fail)
limits: Runs the actual approve command declared in this driver's Step 3, with the existing plan helper in an owned linked worktree. A recorded approved historical Step 3 without an approve call continues without a lane refusal; the same adapter applies to current and historical document bytes. It does not run a model, prove obedience to prose, or judge lane-answer truth. Narrow fenced-command extraction, not a second lane parser. Setup or unsupported command shape is unavailable, never clean. Metadata-only/product-change cases execute the actual fenced product-change check after creating the real approval artifacts. Before that shared check exists they execute the recorded Step 4 status check; this demonstrates the integration regression from new metadata. Final-product cases run the complete declared finish shell block; the control judges its product refusal, reporting but not blocking on compliance's advisory status. Receipt-only, exact product revert, and other-issue evidence are separate inputs.

anchors.why: The historical Step 3 waits for human approval but never invokes the plan-record lane refusal. Given a recorded approval it continues for both the omitted-lane and complete plans.
